title: connect_ws has no connect timeout: hangs indefinitely
description: tokio_tungstenite::connect_async_with_config does not accept a connect timeout; the HTTP path sets a 10-second connect timeout via reqwest::ClientBuilder::connect_timeout. A server that stalls during the TCP/TLS handshake will hang connect_ws forever. Caller wrapping with tokio::time::timeout helps but is not documented. Fix: wrap connect_async_with_config call with tokio::time::timeout and surface as ClientError::WebSocket on expiry.
